clue.text: Wine that in test is tastiest

parts.note: surface padding for the wine-tasting picture; gives no letters

indicators.note: 'in' tells you the answer sits inside the following word, already spelt out in its letters

parts.note: the four letters after the opening T of this word

explanation.surface: A wine-tasting verdict: the bottle that came top in the test was the most delicious.
explanation.walkthrough: ASTI sits inside tASTIest.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling white wine from Piedmont in northern Italy, named after its town.

clue.text: A song I composed recalled city in Asia

indicators.note: something composed has been put together, so the letters are arranged into a fresh order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A songwriter's tune brings back memories of a city in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recalled' belongs to the definition: the city was renamed Ho Chi Minh City in 1976, so Saigon is a remembered name.
explanation.definitionFit: Saigon was the former name of Vietnam's largest city, now officially Ho Chi Minh City.

clue.text: A quartet playing without one again

indicators.note: 'without one' asks you to drop a single member of the group just named

parts.note: taken as written
the four players at a bridge table are North, East, West and South

explanation.surface: A string quartet has to perform again a man short.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quartet playing' suggests musicians, but the four seats at bridge are the compass points N, E, W, S; dropping one of them (S) leaves NEW.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something anew means doing it once more, from a fresh start.

clue.text: Courage — it's needed after rents going up

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means the word is read from the bottom of the column, back to front

parts.note: rents are tears, RIPS, which read upwards becomes this
the word it, with the 's as part of the link 'it is needed'

explanation.surface: A tenant is told it takes nerve to face rising rents.
explanation.walkthrough: Rents here are tears in fabric, not payments to a landlord. 'Needed after' places IT after the reversed tears.
explanation.definitionFit: Spirit as in pluck or mettle: bravery and resolve in the face of difficulty.

clue.text: Musician in band with a string that's broken

indicators.note: a broken thing has come apart, so these letters are reassembled differently

parts.note: a ring-shaped band is drawn as the letter O
taken as written

explanation.surface: A band's guitarist plays on despite a snapped string.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Band' looks like a group of musicians; it is a ring, O, mixed in with the letters of 'a string'.
explanation.definitionFit: An organist is a musician who plays the organ, typically in a church.

clue.text: Section of stadium — work to prepare ground comes to complete halt

parts.note: the stands are a stadium's banks of spectator seating
to till is to plough or dig soil before planting

explanation.surface: Groundwork at a stadium stand grinds to a stop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ground' suggests a sports ground, matching the stadium, but here it is farm soil.
explanation.definitionFit: A standstill is a situation in which all movement or progress has stopped entirely.

clue.text: Killer since caught in dope offence

indicators.note: something caught in a trap is held inside it, so one word goes within the other

parts.note: as can mean since, giving a reason
a sin is a moral offence
a dope is a fool, an ass

explanation.surface: A murderer has been arrested for a drugs crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dope offence' reads as a drugs charge; dope is a fool and the offence is a sin, with the word for since slipped between them.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a murderer, especially one who kills a prominent person for political motives or pay.

clue.text: Kind of creature that is protected by glasses

indicators.note: a thing protected by something is surrounded by it, so one piece is wrapped in the other

parts.note: specs is short for spectacles
i.e., Latin id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A creature whose eyes are shielded by goggles.
explanation.definitionFit: A species is a class of organisms that can interbreed, a biological sort of animal or plant.

clue.text: Egalitarian goal, one accepted by political group

indicators.note: something accepted by a group is taken into it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a political party
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A political party adopts equality as one of its aims.
explanation.definitionFit: Parity means equality of status or pay, which is what egalitarians strive for.

clue.text: Editing letter that contains this slightly shocking sensation

indicators.note: the clue says the words in front hold the answer inside them, spelt out across the gap

parts.note: the letters run across the end of the first word into the start of the second

explanation.surface: An editor tidying a letter finds something faintly scandalous in it.
explanation.walkthrough: TINGLE spans ediTING LEtter. 'Slightly shocking' suggests racy content, but it is a mild electric prickle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tingle is a light prickling or stinging feeling, like a small electric shock.

clue.text: Buckle isn't what belligerent Indian wore

parts.note: to buckle is to bend or warp out of shape
ain't is a colloquial form of isn't

explanation.surface: A buckle wasn't part of a fighting Native American's dress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Buckle' looks like a belt fastening but is a verb meaning bend.
explanation.definitionFit: War paint was the face and body paint Native American warriors put on before going into battle.

clue.text: Undistinguished pair who share an annual celebration

definitions.meaning: first meaning: two people who cannot be told apart
second meaning: siblings with the same birthday

explanation.surface: An unremarkable couple who mark their anniversary together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Undistinguished' usually means mediocre; here it means not distinguishable from each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Identical twins look alike, so cannot be distinguished, and were born on the same day, so share a birthday.

clue.text: Oddly comedic art for party in US

definitions.note: adjective: belonging to one of the two main American parties

indicators.note: done oddly means done in a strange way, so these letters come out in an unusual order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Strangely funny artwork is put on for a party in America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' looks like a letter-selection signal for alternate letters, but those would be far too short; it shuffles the whole phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The Democratic Party is one of the two major political parties in the United States.

clue.text: Conscious a conflict leads to peace, ultimately

parts.note: taken as written
a war is a conflict

indicators.note: ultimately points to the very end, so only the closing letter of the word is used

parts.note: the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A thoughtful observation that war eventually brings peace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leads to' simply places the first pieces before the last letter of 'peace'.
explanation.definitionFit: To be aware is to have knowledge or perception of something, to be mindful of it.

clue.text: Surrounded by support, including large number of Romans

indicators.note: a thing including another holds it within, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: aid is help or support
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A help effort involving many people in ancient Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Amid is a preposition meaning in the middle of, encircled by others.

clue.text: Offering fishing south of Land's End

indicators.note: in a down clue, south of means placed underneath, so it comes later in the column
the end of a word is its final letter, so only that letter is kept

parts.note: the closing letter of the word land
angling is fishing with rod and line

explanation.surface: A tour company advertising fishing trips near Cornwall's westernmost tip.
explanation.walkthrough: Land's End is the far south-west point of England in Cornwall; read literally it is the last letter of 'land'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dangling something before someone, like a carrot, is holding it out as an enticing offer.

clue.text: Rod teachers employed in school

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a stick or pole
second meaning: the personnel of an institution

explanation.surface: A reminder of when teachers in schools wielded the cane.
explanation.definitionFit: A staff is a long walking stick, and the staff of a school are its employed teachers.

clue.text: Fellow put on suit for part of party

indicators.note: in a down clue, put on means set on top, so this piece comes first in the column

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fellow
a lawsuit is a legal action

explanation.surface: A man dresses up in a suit for a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suit' and 'party' suggest clothes and a social event; the suit is legal and the party political.
explanation.definitionFit: A faction is a dissenting group or clique within a larger political party.

clue.text: Understand small piece in plane, say

definitions.meaning: first meaning: grasp, catch on, in informal British use
second meaning: a slender shoot of a tree, such as a plane tree

explanation.surface: Someone trying to grasp what a tiny aircraft component does.
explanation.walkthrough: The plane is a tree, not an aircraft; 'say' marks it as one example. To twig is British slang for to realise.
explanation.definitionFit: A twig is a small branch of a tree, and twigging something means suddenly grasping it.

clue.text: Virtual meeting in France once cell reorganised

indicators.note: reorganised means arranged again in a new way, so these letters take a different order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A wartime French Resistance cell regroups and meets remotely.
explanation.definitionFit: A conference call is a telephone or video call linking several participants who are not physically together.

clue.text: Elected politician in nearby country or group of countries

indicators.note: one thing in another sits within it, so the first piece is placed inside the second

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name for Ireland, Britain's neighbour
a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A British MP working in neighbouring Ireland or across a bloc of nations.
explanation.definitionFit: An empire is a set of nations or territories ruled by a single sovereign power.

clue.text: Actors possibly do this to share the limelight

definitions.text: do this to share the limelight

indicators.note: possibly signals one of several arrangements, so the letters may be put in another order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Performers may agree to equal billing so neither steals the spotlight.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes what actors do; the first word is both subject and fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To co-star is to appear as one of two or more leading performers with equal prominence.

clue.text: Follows target in alley in greatly agitated state

parts.note: to tail someone is to follow them covertly
the pins are the targets in a bowling alley

explanation.surface: A detective shadows a suspect down an alley in a frantic state.
explanation.walkthrough: The alley is a bowling alley, where the targets are skittle-shaped pins.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailspin is an aircraft's spiralling dive, used figuratively for a state of panic or chaos.

clue.text: Unfashionable female admirer upset

indicators.note: upset means turned over, and in a down clue that turns the letters to read bottom to top

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for female
a fan is an admirer

explanation.surface: A woman is upset that her devotee is dowdy.
explanation.walkthrough: Naff is British slang for tacky or uncool.
explanation.definitionFit: Naff describes something lacking style or taste, cheap-looking and out of fashion.

clue.text: For example, fly within breakaway formation

parts.note: in means within
a sect is a group that has split from a larger body

explanation.surface: An example of flying in a breakaway formation, like aircraft or birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fly' reads as a verb about formation flying; it is the noun, the insect.
explanation.definitionFit: A fly is one example of an insect, the six-legged creatures, hence the 'for example'.

clue.text: Most of KGB, reportedly, is secretive

indicators.note: most of means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped
reportedly means as it is said, so the letter names are heard rather than read

parts.note: the initials less their last letter, spoken as letter names

explanation.surface: Most of the Soviet spy agency is said to be tight-lipped.
explanation.walkthrough: The KGB was the Soviet secret police, which fits 'secretive' perfectly in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Cagy (or cagey) means reluctant to give information, guarded and evasive.

clue.text: Person straying with second less than perfect shot

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for second
in archery or shooting, the inner is the ring just outside the bullseye

explanation.surface: Someone wandering off with a second-rate attempt.
explanation.walkthrough: On a target the bull is the perfect hit; a shot in the next ring is an inner.
explanation.definitionFit: A sinner is one who strays from the path of moral righteousness.

clue.text: Spanish dance ends off fiesta with new energy

indicators.note: with here does double duty, being both the inserted word and the sign that it sits among those letters
the ends of a word are its first and last letters, so only those two are kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of this word
and means with, together with
N is the abbreviation for new
go means energy, vigour

explanation.surface: A lively Spanish dance closes the festival with fresh vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: The word for 'with' is held between the two outer letters of 'fiesta' rather than simply following them. 'Off' is read as 'of'; go is a common crossword word for energy.
explanation.definitionFit: The fandango is a lively Spanish courtship dance in triple time, performed with castanets.
